description: #653: the output size a canvas-sourced turn sends: the canvas is a ratio (named from its pixels: a ratio_pixels key of its shape, or the exact pixels the Schema maps a ratio to, else width:height in lowest terms), and the model gives the size with the most pixels at that ratio (its options, its largest custom size within image_size, its highest resolution tier a person may choose), else at the nearest ratio it has ('nearest' true). 'pixels' is what a ratio-only value produces by the Schema tables; 'also' are other values the canvas sets. Offerings are the default Product Schema's, or the ones under 'offerings'. #296: cases with source 'reference' are a chat edit of one uploaded picture of width x height with no size chosen: the legal size closest to it; 'nearest' is true for a size of another shape. Read by TestCanvasTurnSizesSharedWithTheWebClient (Go: canvasRatioValues / referenceSizeValues, forced values, the size notes) and by src/lib/workspace/canvas-size.test.ts (canvasRatioTurnOutput / referenceTurnOutput, which drive the size notices), so both sides must agree.
